hazards.description: There is no physical separation or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the travel lane, exposing pedestrians to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning near the curb.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left side shows signs of cracking and uneven pavement, which can be a trip hazard.

hazards.name: Empty tree pit
hazards.description: An unpaved, empty tree pit in the sidewalk creates a trip hazard and reduces the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Commercial Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large truck and trailer are parked along the right curb, obstructing sightlines and potentially encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck parked at the curb blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street blocks sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A wide curb cut and roll-up garage door create a point where vehicles may cross the pedestrian walkway unexpectedly.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left at the brick building with the silver roll-up door

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Wide Curb Cut
hazards.description: The large paved apron on the right side allows vehicles to enter or exit the commercial property at any point, creating unpredictable conflict zones with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image in front of the commercial building

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Merchandise displays and temporary fencing narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image in front of the commercial storefronts

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area where people are gathered.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: There is no planting strip or physical barrier between the walking area and the parking/travel lanes, increasing exposure to traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to provide designated and safer crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Definition
interventions.description: Install curbs, bollards, or planters to define specific, narrow entry and exit points for the parking lot, separating the rest of the sidewalk from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the parking area to provide a physical and psychological barrier for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian lighting to improve visibility and security along the wide sidewalk and parking lot edge.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated areas for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or other vertical deflection to manage vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the furniture zone near the curb or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install street trees and a dedicated furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Repair
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk on the left side and repair existing surfaces to ensure an unobstructed path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven patches.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Fill empty tree pits with street trees to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and create a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Implement specific curb management for commercial loading to prevent large vehicles from obstructing sidewalks and sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded roadway surface to eliminate potholes and trip hazards.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the garage entrance to improve sightlines for both exiting drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signs to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Defined Sidewalk and Buffer
interventions.description: Delineate a clear pedestrian path on the right side using bollards or a planting strip to separate walkers from the parking/loading area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the wide sidewalk and moving traffic.
